classification.difficultyReason: Calculate a cylinder volume from its diameter and height, then apply the cubed similarity ratio to obtain an exact volume.

content.prompt: These cylinders are similar. What is the volume of the smaller cylinder? Answer in terms of $\pi$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 16, paired cylinders at the bottom left
spec.description: Two upright similar cylinders, larger on the left and smaller on the right. Diameter arrows label 28 and 10; an external vertical arrow labels the larger height 42. Black unshaded reconstruction replaces decorative red source shading. Top rims are visible complete ellipses; lower rear rims are occluded, with only front lower arcs drawn.
spec.mathematics: Larger diameter 28 and height 42; smaller diameter 10. No length units or smaller height are supplied. The smaller-to-larger length ratio is 10:28. Cylinder coordinates use corresponding diameter and height proportions, without printing a derived smaller height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions are visible; no calculated radius, smaller height or volume is shown.

answer.worked:
Length ratio, smaller : larger: $10:28=5:14$.

Volume ratio, smaller : larger: $5^3:14^3=125:2744$.

$$\begin{align*}
V_{\text{larger}}&=\pi(14)^2(42)\\
&=8232\pi\text{ units}^3\\
\frac{x}{\pi(14)^2(42)}&=\left(\frac{10}{28}\right)^3\\
x&=8232\pi\times\frac{125}{2744}\\
x&=375\pi\text{ units}^3
\end{align*}$$
